verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS CRM and its official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The ABAC access-policy item is an adjacent data-access feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
